best_lineage.idea: Implement a high-performance LSD Radix Sort with 11-bit digits (3 passes total) to maximize throughput on random data, utilizing a single scratch buffer and optimized histogramming.

Implement a hybrid approach using a fast check for sorted/reverse-sorted runs, and use a highly optimized LSD Radix Sort with 8-bit digits (4 passes) and a single buffer, as 8-bit digits provide better cache locality for the prefix sum and reordering steps on large $n$.
Switch to a 3-pass radix sort with 11-11-10 bit partitioning to reduce the number of passes and memory traversals, which is much faster for large $n$ on most distributions.
